body.purpose: Ant Design default UI type for HUD, transcript, and controls.

narrative.overview: Agent Core presents identity, session rail, transcript, and composer with Ant Design v6. Product components import Layout, Select, Button, Input, Empty, Spin, Tag, Alert, Progress, and Typography directly. Minimal app.css handles full-height shell, overflow, preview sizing, and the hidden attachment input. Status remains labeled. Pixel Dialogue Field, Martian Mono, bevels, phosphor, and decorative plates are retired.
keyCharacteristics: Default Ant Design controls without a wrapper layer
Session rail plus conversation pane on desktop; drawer sessions on narrow viewports
Transcript maps HistoryEntry[]; composer keeps product send/voice/attachment callbacks
No custom Select, token catalog, or pixel-art presentation

rules.name: Direct AntD Rule
rules.body: Import antd in product components. Do not invent a design-system wrapper.

rules.name: Docs Win Rule
rules.body: DESIGN.md is lightweight presentation only. /docs owns screens and behavior.

dos: Do keep labeled controls and the composer during voice.
Do use Ant Design Empty/Spin/Alert for empty, loading, and recoverable errors.
Do keep attachment previews on authenticated blob URLs, not antd Image with public URLs.
donts: Don't restore Pixel Dialogue Field, Martian Mono, plates, bevels, or phosphor.
Don't add Ant Design Pro/ProComponents/X or another CSS framework.
Don't hide Voice/Mute/End behind icon-only controls unless /docs and tests change together.
